name: Apply Wall Primer (Spray + Backroll)
intent: Spray PVA primer onto bare drywall and immediately backroll the wet film. NC production standard for prime. Spray pass is fast, backroll works the primer into mud joints and texture. Single coat regardless of QT. No ceiling cutin needed because spray pattern handles the ceiling line cleanly.
doctrine: Spray primer (600 SF/hr baseline) is meaningfully faster than spray finish because primer is thicker and lays down with fewer passes. Backroll (400 SF/hr baseline) handles filling into texture and joint absorption. FAC_TEXTURE eligibility is author-set via the Modifier Editor UI — set per-task if one task (e.g. spray) should opt out while another (e.g. backroll) stays on. QT4 spray slowdown comes from FAC_QT. No ceiling cutin task — spray handles the ceiling edge cleanly, the finish painter establishes the visible cut line later.
